title: GoThru Photographer API Go Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #94: Professional services for image processing profiles: table, dashboard API and detail field
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Image processing profiles on the frontend (/image-processing/[slug]) render a "Professional Services" section: one tile per service, each with an icon, a name and an optional "View Sample" link. The only data behind it today is the services lookup (photographers_services), which has neither an icon nor a link, so the tiles cannot show either. Image processing photographers need their own editable, ordered list.

Requirements

  1. New table photographers_professional_services, delivered as a SQL file that is run by hand (the repo has no migration tool):
    • id, photographer_id (FK to photographers.id, ON DELETE CASCADE), icon text null, name text not null, link text null, order int not null (display order), created_at, updated_at.
  2. GET /v1/photographers/:identifier/professional-services returns the photographer's list ordered by order. :identifier is a gothruUserId or a slug, as on the other dashboard endpoints.
  3. PUT /v1/photographers/:identifier/professional-services with {"services": [{"icon", "name", "link"}]} replaces the whole list in one transaction. Array position becomes order, starting at 1.
    • name is required, trimmed, and at most 150 characters.
    • icon is optional: the name of an uploaded icon asset, 1–100 letters, digits, - or _.
    • link is optional: an absolute http or https URL.
    • At most 20 items. An empty array clears the list; a body without services is rejected rather than treated as empty.
    • Returns 400 for invalid input or for a photographer whose role is not image_processing, and 404 for an unknown photographer.
    • Like portfolio and equipment writes, a save clears the photographer's detail cache, recomputes ranking, and reverts an approved profile to pending.
  4. GET /v1/photographers/:slug gains professionalServices: [{id, icon, name, link, order}]. It is filled only for image_processing photographers; every other role gets [] without an extra query. services is unchanged.

Acceptance criteria

  • The SQL file creates the table on MySQL 8.
  • On dev, a PUT followed by a GET returns the list in the submitted order, and a PUT for a photographer_360 photographer returns 400.
  • The detail of an image_processing photographer includes the list.
  • sqlmock unit tests cover validation, the role check, the replace transaction, and the detail field. make test passes.

Notes

  • Until the SQL file has been run, the detail field is [] and the two dashboard endpoints return 500; nothing else is affected.
  • Rows are removed with their photographer by the foreign key's ON DELETE CASCADE.
  • Like the other dashboard endpoints, these have no auth middleware.
  • The frontend follow-up (render the list on image processing profiles and map icon to the uploaded assets) will be a separate issue in the frontend repo.

issues.display_title: Issue #89: Photographer detail 404s for the non-ASCII slugs the list and redirect endpoints emit
issues.main_description_html:
Description

GET /v1/photographers/:slug only resolves the ASCII-folded form of a slug (jorg-halisch-yk06), but GET /v2/photographers/users and GET /v1/photographers/slugs?redirect= both emit the accented form (jörg-halisch-yk06) with isRedirect: false.

Every link the site produces for these photographers — directory cards, the map list, /sitemap.xml — therefore points at a URL that 404s. 8 of 165 published profiles are unreachable this way, on production today.

slug as emitted by v2 list / redirect lookup /v1/photographers/:slug ASCII-folded form /v1/photographers/:slug
jörg-halisch-yk06 404 jorg-halisch-yk06 200
jose-mª-laffitte-29pr 404 jose-ma-laffitte-29pr 200
frédéric-lipzyc-py6b 404 frederic-lipzyc-py6b 200
gabriel-latorre-gonçalves-uxo4 404 gabriel-latorre-goncalves-uxo4 200
martin-hrdlička-k3xd 404 martin-hrdlicka-k3xd 200
filip-pavlíček-pdd5 404 filip-pavlicek-pdd5 200
martin-šturcel-lwd3 404 martin-sturcel-lwd3 200
miguel-goiás-4sg6 404 miguel-goias-4sg6 200

Folded = NFKD normalisation with combining marks dropped. Every other URL variant tried (percent-encoded, NFD, oe transliteration) also 404s.

Reproduce

B=http://<api-host>:3008
# what the list emits
curl -s "$B/v2/photographers/users?size=100" | jq -r '.data.photographers[].slug' | grep -P '[^\x00-\x7F]'
# the redirect lookup agrees with the list and says it is canonical
curl -s "$B/v1/photographers/slugs?redirect=j%C3%B6rg-halisch-yk06"
# {"data":{"gothruUserId":2422,"slug":"jörg-halisch-yk06","fullname":"Jörg Halisch","isRedirect":false}}
# but the detail endpoint cannot resolve it
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "$B/v1/photographers/j%C3%B6rg-halisch-yk06"   # 404
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "$B/v1/photographers/jorg-halisch-yk06"        # 200

Same on production: https://360photographers.org/photographer/j%C3%B6rg-halisch-yk06 → 404.

Likely cause

The slug is stored or matched in its folded form for the detail lookup, while the list and the redirect lookup return the un-folded display value (or vice versa). The three code paths disagree on what the canonical slug is.

Suggested fix

Pick one canonical form and make all three endpoints agree. Two options, not exclusive:

  1. Detail endpoint folds the incoming slug before lookup. Smallest change, and tolerant of both forms already in the wild.
  2. List and redirect endpoints emit the folded slug. If slugs?redirect= returns { "slug": "jorg-halisch-yk06", "isRedirect": true } for the accented input, the frontend's existing proxy already 301s old links to the working URL with no frontend change (src/proxy.ts checkPhotographerRedirect).

Acceptance criteria

  1. Every slug returned by GET /v2/photographers/users resolves with 200 on GET /v1/photographers/:slug.
  2. GET /v1/photographers/slugs?redirect=<accented form> either resolves as canonical or returns the canonical slug with isRedirect: true.
  3. All 8 profiles above load on 360photographers.org/photographer/<slug> from the directory, the map, and /sitemap.xml.

Context

Found while verifying GoThruMedia/gothru-photographer-v2#43 (sitemap for #87): every URL in /sitemap.xml was curled against a production build, and these 8 were the only failures left. Frontend passes the slug through unchanged; nothing to fix there until the API agrees with itself.

issues.display_title: Issue #91: v2 photographer list: filter by role and return role-scoped equipment
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The frontend's /hire-image-processing directory still renders mock editors, because no public list endpoint returns role=image_processing photographers. GET /v2/photographers/users already includes role, timezone, language and role-scoped services on every item (#73). It still ignores a role query, though, and it returns no equipment. The directory needs equipment for its Software chips and Software filter (frontend PRD R12, R24, R29).

Measured on the dev backend (192.168.1.194:3008) on 2026-09-11:

request total roles returned
/v2/photographers/users?size=200 165 photographer_360=165
…&role=image_processing 165 photographer_360=165
…&role=bogus 165 photographer_360=165

Requirements

  1. GET /v2/photographers/users accepts a role query parameter:
    • photographer_360 or image_processing returns only photographers whose photographers.role matches.
    • An omitted or empty role returns every role, as it does today.
    • Any other value returns 400 with the same invalid-role error that GET /v1/photographers/services?role= returns.
  2. The Redis key for this list includes the role, so a filtered page never reads or overwrites the unfiltered cache entry.
  3. Every item gains equipment, grouped the same way as on the detail endpoint: [{ "name": "Software", "items": [{ "brand", "model", "specification" }] }].
    • Only equipment types the photographer's role allows are included (helpers.RoleEquipmentTypes: 1–4 for photographer_360, 5 for image_processing).
    • Group names come from the equipment type catalog.
    • The whole page is loaded in one batched query.
  4. Pagination, search, location filters, ranking order and all other response fields stay the same.

Acceptance criteria

  • On dev, role=image_processing returns only image_processing photographers (0 today), role=photographer_360 returns the current 165, and role=bogus returns 400.
  • No item's equipment contains a type its role does not allow.
  • sqlmock unit tests cover the role clause, the 400 and the cache key, and make test passes.

Notes

Keyset pagination with any filter is affected by the open cursor bug in #84. The role filter inherits that bug; this issue does not fix it.

issues.display_title: Issue #92: Photographer detail: return role, timezone and language, and name the Software equipment group
issues.main_description_html:
Description

GET /v1/photographers/:slug backs both /photographer/[slug] and /image-processing/[slug] on the frontend. The frontend renders an image-processing profile only when the detail says role: "image_processing". The endpoint returns no role, timezone or language field at all, so a real editor's profile can never be shown.

Measured on dev on 2026-09-11: GET /v1/photographers/samuellawrence has no role, timezone or language field.

Equipment has a second problem: group names come from a map that stops at type 4, so type 5 (Software) is returned as a group named "".

Requirements

  1. The response includes role, timezone and language (the raw CSV), matching GET /v2/photographers/users.
  2. Every equipment group is named from the equipment type catalog, so type 5 is named "Software".
  3. Every other field is unchanged.

Out of scope

The frontend PRD also asks for role-compatible services on this endpoint. Role-scoping them would drop image-processing services, such as Nadir Patching (48 profiles), Image Color Correction (47), Image Stitching (25) and Floor Plan Creation (17), from photographer_360 profiles that selected them before the role split. That would be a visible change to live profiles, so it needs its own decision.

Acceptance criteria

  • GET /v1/photographers/samuellawrence returns "role": "photographer_360", its timezone and language, and the same services and equipment as today.
  • A type 5 equipment item is returned in a group named Software.
  • Unit tests cover the new fields and the group naming, and make test passes.
